structural_findings.finding: Three active bond funds consume 69.78% of account assets, but current official evidence is insufficient to quantify duration, credit, leverage, convertible and security-level overlap across all three.
structural_findings.intended_exposure: Defensive fixed-income anchor and lower account drawdown.
structural_findings.unwanted_risk: Hidden duplication, unintended convertible/equity beta, manager-style drift and concentration in similar financial-credit instruments.
structural_findings.binding_constraint: 110017.OF current Q2 look-through is incomplete; 217003.OF Q2 return attribution and manager-change effects are unresolved.
required_next_evidence: 2026 Q2 allocation, duration, leverage, credit rating and top holdings for all three funds.
Security-level overlap matrix and common issuer exposure.
Fee and redemption-cost comparison at the user's actual holding period.

structural_findings.finding: 159612.SZ and 159655.SZ provide substantially the same strategic S&P 500 exposure and together represent 9.20% of account assets.
structural_findings.intended_exposure: US large-cap equity beta and geographic diversification.
structural_findings.unwanted_risk: Operational duplication without meaningful strategic diversification; premium/discount and tracking differences can create avoidable execution risk.
structural_findings.binding_constraint: A single retained vehicle cannot be selected without a same-session comparison of liquidity, bid-ask spread, premium/discount, tracking difference and exit cost.
selection_rule: Prefer the vehicle with lower persistent premium risk and tighter effective spread.
Require no worse management and custody fees; both current published fee schedules are 0.60% and 0.15%.
Do not consolidate during an abnormal QDII premium episode.
Any sale requires explicit user approval and updated transaction continuity.

structural_findings.finding: The CSI 500 satellite sleeve is 13.21% of assets while the A500 broad-core sleeve is 7.78%; for a stable-growth architecture the higher-volatility mid-cap satellite is currently larger than the broad-core sleeve.
structural_findings.intended_exposure: A-share broad-market growth plus a measured mid-cap return satellite.
structural_findings.unwanted_risk: Portfolio beta is tilted more heavily toward mid-cap, cyclical and higher-volatility exposure than the declared core-satellite structure implies.
structural_findings.binding_constraint: No fresh completed close after 2026-07-24 and no user continuity confirmation beyond that date.

decision_queue.action: Complete three-fund overlap, duration, credit and convertible-beta analysis before any add or consolidation decision.
Compare both ETFs on a completed session and nominate one retained vehicle; no trade is authorized.
Adopt A500 as core and CSI500 as satellite; direct future equity additions to A500 until the core is no smaller than the satellite.

recommendation_summary.new_money_rule: NO_AUTOMATIC_DEPLOYMENT; if user later authorizes A-share additions, prioritize A500 over CSI500 until role inversion is corrected.
